proof_body:
by
  intro n _ L _ _ _
  have h := Polynomial.cyclotomic.irreducible_rat (NeZero.pos n)
  exact ⟨IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {n} ℚ L, IsCyclotomicExtension.finrank L h, ⟨IsCyclotomicExtension.autEquivPow L h⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L], IsGalois ℚ L ∧ Module.finrank ℚ L = n.totient ∧ Nonempty ((L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) ≃* (ZMod n)ˣ)
